_comment: FIS Mogul Basic Degree of Difficulty and Common Combinations, version 2026 (print date 14.10.2026, published on fis-ski.com SBFSFK Documents 2026-10-14). Codes as printed on FIS result PDFs. Adds basic grab 'g' (+0.05); advanced grab 'G' is +0.12 (was +0.14). Composite codes (e.g. 'TST', 'bpp') are not enumerated; the DD printed on the PDF is trusted and checked for within-season consistency.
notes: Straight jumps: Single/Double/Triple/Quad/Quint base 0.40/0.53/0.65/0.76/0.86 (M) and +0.10 (W); upright modifiers T -0.02, S -0.02, D/X/Y/M/K +0.01, Z 0.00 — printed codes like 'TST' are sums that this table does not enumerate.

Jump multipliers: position p +0.03, layout L +0.03, basic grab g +0.05, advanced grab G +0.12, grab rotation multiplier +0.02 per additional full rotation (e.g. 10g = 1.02 + 0.05 + 0.02x2 = 1.11). Women = men + 0.10 for every jump.
Off-axis jumps are listed only with a position or grab modifier, plus 14o (1.19).
